poem.content:
In the estate of code, where petals bloom
A pet of science, a digital boon
A bronze light glows, as transactions flow
Through the swarm of nodes, where data does grow

In this world of plastic, where norms are bent
A bonus for those who lend, a payment to invent
A curve of debt, where borrowers do stray
Inflicting guilt, on those who can't pay

A pencil scratches, on the blockchain's page
A record of each, in a digital age
Normal transactions, a never-ending stream
But for those who disagree, the cost is extreme

The estate of Solana, where values are made
A science of trust, in a world of trade
A bronze foundation, where the swarm does stand
A glow of innovation, in a digital land

But when guilt does creep, and debt does weigh
A payment due, can turn to dismay
A curve of fate, where fortunes do shift
And those who borrow, may forever drift

Yet in this world of code, where science does reign
A pet of progress, brings hope to sustain
A bonus for the brave, who venture to explore
A normal world of transactions, forever in store.
